description: Workspace (ws) folder of each MLPerf Inference run reported in docs/MLSys/main.tex, per task and arm. Controlled multi-trial studies are tracked by their campaign ledger and run overrides. Paths are relative to the repository root. GIFT-Eval runs are not tracked here.

v1.note: C0 trial 1 remains in tasks.3d-unet-kits19 (full-run task); C0 trials 2–3 are in runs/3d-unet-kits19-v1/c0. The campaign ledger records all trials; audits are in runs/3d-unet-kits19-v1/audit.

v2.note: C2 hides the target voxel spacing; C5 removes the inference harness.

v3.note: All C0–C6 tasks use the same mask as their v2 condition, with the matching v2 run staged read-only; all 63 v3 runs are complete.

v4-pilot.note: Pilot after ledger #98 (isolated CODEX_HOME) and #100 (prompt states ./repo has no Git metadata): C0 only, skill arm, three concurrent trials, gpt-5.6-sol medium.

v4.note: Repeat of v2 under the fixed harness and the skill as of ledger #111 (fixes #100-#111; scoring #112-#113): C0-C6 x plain/skill/builder-skill x 3 trials, gpt-5.6-sol medium, one shared A100 80GB in Slurm. Earlier v4 attempts are listed under superseded_runs in campaign.json.

v5.note: Repeat of v3 under the v4 harness and skill (ledger #111) and scoring (#113): each v4 C0-C6 mask, with the same-condition, -arm, -trial v4 run staged read-only in ./prior-artifacts (dataset/tasks/mlperf-c0-c6/3d-unet-kits19-v5-prior-artifacts.json).

v6.note: Repeat of v5 with both earlier solutions: each v4 C0-C6 mask, with the same-condition, -arm, -trial v4 run and v5 run staged read-only in ./prior-artifacts/v4 and ./prior-artifacts/v5 (dataset/tasks/mlperf-c0-c6/3d-unet-kits19-v6-prior-artifacts.json). Trials ran one at a time.

v1.note: 7 conditions x 3 arms x 3 trials. C2/C4 trial 1 are the reruns with C0's prompt (ledger #117); the earlier C2/C4 trial 1 (campaign-c2-c4.json) used the superseded wording and is not counted.

v2.note: Repeat of v1: the same masks and prompts, with the same-condition, -arm, -trial v1 run staged read-only in ./prior-artifacts (ledger #119). 7 conditions x 3 arms x 3 trials.
